definition: a person who is in charge of people and work
example: Marta is a logistics manager in a big company.

definition: things that people make and sell
example: Logistics is the work of moving goods from one place to another.
Good logistics means the customer gets the right product at the right time.

definition: the work of moving and storing goods
example: Logistics is the work of moving goods from one place to another.

definition: all the steps from the factory to the customer
example: Every step is part of the supply chain.

definition: to ask a company to send you goods

definition: having the job of taking care of something
example: She is responsible for the budget, and she must not spend too much money.

definition: the last day or time to finish something

definition: the road or way from one place to another

definition: to put goods into a truck or a ship

definition: a person who drives a truck or a car

definition: a group of goods that are sent together

definition: a situation when something is late
